title: Workshop safety station
visual_facts: Two large white pegboards are mounted side by side on a wall.
Red first aid boxes and individually packaged protective items hang from hooks on the boards.
A pair of protective goggles hangs near the upper middle of the right board.
A white basket containing bottles and small items sits near the bottom right.
Signs above the boards read SAFETY STATION, EMERGENCY, and PROTECTIVE.
An evacuation procedure notice and maps are posted on the left board.
A poster at the lower right reads INNO Induction and SAFETY FIRST.
spatial_relations: The safety signs are mounted above the pegboards.
First aid boxes hang along the lower left portion of the boards, while protective equipment occupies the upper and right areas.
uncertainties: Small print on packages and instruction sheets is not legible.
The image does not establish which specific items are stored inside the packages.
